t: The MARK PIR motion sensor provides reliable automatic lighting control for various applications. This IP65-rated, recess-mounted sensor is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, making it ideal for security lighting in commercial premises or for convenience in domestic garages and workshops. It offers a 360° detection range with an 8m diameter at a 2.4m mounting height, ensuring comprehensive coverage. The adjustable time-on setting, from 10 seconds to 15 minutes, allows customisation for specific needs, while the robust polycarbonate body ensures durability.
